home_title: Ось — a business browser built around privacy
home_desc: Ось is a business browser focused on privacy: an isolated profile for every account, tracking protection, and your data stays on your device.
hero_badge: Android and Windows · iOS and macOS coming soon
hero_title: A business browser where *privacy* comes first
hero_lead: A separate profile for every account: work, personal, clients. Tracking protection, its own tabs in each profile, and your data stays on your device — Ось has no servers or analytics of its own.
pr1_d: History, notes and files are stored only on the device
pr2_d: The developer collects no data about you
pr3_d: GeckoView (Firefox) on Android, Chromium on Windows
pr4_d: Including Arabic, written right to left
feat_title: Everything for working with several accounts
feat_lead: Ось is made for people whose mail, CRM and social networks live in different accounts — and who don't want those accounts to know about each other.
f1_d: Up to 50 isolated profiles with their own sign-ins, cookies and history. Work mail in one, personal mail in another.
f2_d: Each profile has pinned tabs, open tabs, groups, a tab grid and tab search.
f3_d: Blocks social trackers, cryptominers and fingerprinters; third-party cookies are isolated per site.
f4_d: Reader mode without clutter, saving pages as PDF and reading without internet.
f5_d: Select text on a page and tap “Add to note”. Notes and profile files stay on the device.
f6_d: You see right away which account a message came from: “Work · mail.example.com”.
prof_lead: Each profile is a separate browser inside Ось. A site opened in “Work” can't see the cookies and sign-ins from “Personal”. No need to sign out of one account to sign in to another.
prof_li1: Reorder profiles by dragging; add a description and attached files
prof_li2: Quick search on the home screen opens the right profile
prof_li3: Incognito saves nothing — no history, no cookies
p1_d: Fingerprint or PIN; content is hidden in the app switcher and on screenshots.
p2_d: Camera, microphone, location, notifications and downloads — only with your consent, site by site.
p3_d: One screen shows HTTPS, granted permissions, tracking protection and the lock.
p4_d: A mode in which insecure sites won't open without a warning.
p5_d: DuckDuckGo by default; you can choose Startpage, Brave, Google, Bing or Yandex.
p6_d: A file is saved only after you tap “Allow”; the choice can be remembered for the site.
plat_title: One Ось on all your devices
faq1_a: [Answer: distribution model — to be confirmed by the product owner]
faq2_q: How is a profile different from an incognito tab?
faq2_a: A profile remembers sign-ins and cookies between launches, but separately from other profiles. Incognito erases everything when closed.
faq3_a: Nowhere: Ось has no servers of its own. History, notes, saved pages and profile files are stored only on the device.
faq4_q: Will there be sync between phone and computer?
faq4_a: Sync needs a server with on-device encryption; it is planned and will be turned on only if you want it.

cl_lead: Changes in each build are collected automatically from the project's releases. Change descriptions are given in English, as in the project history.
cl_none: Maintenance build: no changes to this platform's code.
fp_desc: Profiles, tabs and groups, reading and offline, notes, notifications and statistics in Ось for Android and Windows.
fp_lead: Everything Ось can do today on Android and Windows. Every feature works locally, without our servers.
fp_prof_1: From 1 to 50 isolated profiles. Each has its own sign-ins, cookies, site storage and history.
fp_prof_2: Name, colour, description and attached files for every profile; change the order by dragging.
fp_prof_3: On first launch Ось suggests example profiles — Personal, Work, Shopping, Social — that you can rename.
fp_tabs_1: Pinned tabs shared by all profiles and pinned tabs of each profile.
fp_tabs_2: Open tabs, tab groups, a grid of tabs and search across tabs.
fp_tabs_3: On Windows: Ctrl+T, Ctrl+W, Ctrl+Tab, Ctrl+Shift+T to reopen a closed tab, and dragging tabs.
fp_read_1: Reader mode removes everything except the text and images of the article.
fp_read_2: Save a page as PDF to “Saved pages” and read it without internet.
fp_notes_1: Select text and choose “Add to note”; you can also copy, share or search the selection.
fp_notes_2: Notes are stored only on the device.
fp_notif_1: Site notifications arrive with the profile name, so you know which account they belong to.
fp_notif_2: Tapping a notification opens the right tab. Sites can send notifications only after your permission and while Ось is running.
fp_stats_1: How many pages each profile opened and how many trackers were blocked.
fp_stats_2: The counters are kept only on the device and can be reset.
fp_more_1: Bookmarks with folders, history and downloads with pause and resume.
fp_more_2: Six themes, including light, dark and OLED.
fp_more_3: Address bar at the top or bottom on Android; Ось can be set as the default browser.
ps_desc: How Ось protects your data: what is stored and where, tracking protection, site permissions and app lock.
ps_lead: A plain-language description of what Ось protects you from, how, and where its protection ends.
ps_store_d: Everything Ось keeps is stored on your device. The developer receives nothing.
ps_row1_w: On the device, separately for each profile
ps_row1_d: “Clear” → sign out of the profile's accounts
ps_row2_d: “Clear” in the browser or Settings → Data
ps_net_1: Ось connects to the sites you open and to the search engine you chose.
ps_net_2: The Windows version checks for updates in the project's GitHub releases; this can be turned off in settings.
ps_net_3: There is no analytics, telemetry or crash reporting — the diagnostics log stays on the device.
ps_track_1: On Android — the standard tracking protection of GeckoView (Firefox): social trackers, cryptominers and fingerprinters are blocked.
ps_track_2: On Windows — blocking by the EasyPrivacy list; third-party cookies are cut from requests of embedded sites.
ps_track_3: The number of blocked trackers is shown in statistics.
ps_perm_1: Camera, microphone, location, notifications and downloads are requested from you, for each site separately.
ps_perm_2: Decisions can be reviewed and revoked in site settings; the security check shows everything on one screen.
ps_lock_1: Android: fingerprint or PIN; content is hidden in recent apps, and screenshots are blocked.
ps_lock_2: Windows: PIN; the window can be hidden from screen recording.
ps_limits_t: What Ось does not protect against
ps_limits_1: Sites you sign in to see what you do on them.
ps_limits_2: Your network provider can see which sites you connect to. Ось is not a VPN.
ps_limits_3: Malware on the device or someone who knows your PIN can access your data.
biz_desc: Ось for teams and work accounts: a separate profile for each client, data on the employee's device, no telemetry.
biz_lead: For people who work in many accounts at once: agencies, sales, support, freelancers.
biz_1_d: Each client's accounts live in their own profile and never mix with others.
biz_2_d: No vendor cloud and no telemetry: there is nothing to send to third parties.
biz_3_d: Camera, microphone, location and downloads only with consent, site by site; app lock with a PIN.
biz_4_d: A standard installer and a portable zip version; updates come from the project's releases.
